All possible annotation segments of the recordings

Source: R/05b_groundtruth_sample.R
pam_recall_frame.Rd

Cuts every QC-passed, in-deployment recording into consecutive, non-overlapping segments of segment_s seconds (a final piece shorter than a segment is dropped).

Usage

pam_recall_frame(master, segment_s = 60, hours = NULL)

Arguments

master

Table with rel, grid, recording_start (POSIXct, local), duration_s, qc_pass, in_deployment.

segment_s

Segment length in seconds.

hours

Optional c(from, to): keep only segments whose local start hour is >= from and < to (e.g. c(4, 18)).

Value

A data.table with one row per segment: rel, grid, recording_start, seg_start, seg_end (seconds into the file), slot_time, hour, seg_key.
